selection: Restore the simpler 0.4.1 implementation after the IPC notification candidate failed to improve hosted performance. All candidate outcomes remain public.

protocol.work: sleep 0.20, exact output artifact, exactly-one append effect
protocol.concurrency: four simultaneous RDC calls or one four-worker Commander batch
protocol.timing: initialized clients; launch through independently verified artifacts and client close
protocol.polling: RDC concurrent per-worker polling; Commander server-side batch collection
protocol.metric: RDC median elapsed / Commander median elapsed; every Commander outcome must verify
protocol.planning: deterministic MCP client; no LLM planner

stopping: Exactly 50 paired alternating rounds. No optional early stop, replacement of failed samples, pooling with selection samples, or rerun based on the measured ratio.
gate: All outcomes verified, unchanged source, and lower bound of the existing paired 95 percent bootstrap interval at least 2.
limits: A final independent replication after candidate selection; earlier negative measurements remain part of the evidence.
This measures deterministic command execution, not general ChatGPT reliability or model-driven agent productivity.
